"Erstelle ein neues mobiles Fantasy-Klicker-RPG namens AETHERIA für Android.

CHARAKTERERSTELLUNG:

- Männlich oder weiblich, eigener Charaktername.
- Fraktion: Angels oder Demons.
- Drei Klassen: Warrior (Nahkampf), Mage (Magie), Assassin (schnelle Angriffe und kritische Treffer).
- Eigene Waffen, Rüstungen und Fähigkeiten pro Klasse.

KAMPFSYSTEM:
Der Spieler sieht seinen Charakter gegen Monster kämpfen. Angriffe werden ausschließlich durch manuelles Tippen auf die Angriffstaste ausgelöst. KEIN Auto-Angriff und KEIN Auto-Kampf! Jeder Klick verursacht sichtbaren Schaden. Spezialfähigkeiten haben eigene Buttons. Zeige Kampfanimationen, Schadenszahlen, Lebensbalken und Bossangriffe.

CHARAKTERENTWICKLUNG:
Erfahrung, Levelaufstiege, stärkere Werte, verbesserbare Fähigkeiten und immer schwierigere Monster. Integriere ein Prestige-System mit dauerhaften Boni.

AUSRÜSTUNG:
9 Ausrüstungsslots, verschiedene Seltenheiten, Klassenbeschränkungen, Monster-Drops, Bossbelohnungen und Crafting. Vier identische Gegenstände fusionieren: T3 → T2 → T1 → nächste Seltenheit T3. Vier Legendary ergeben Mythic, vier Mythic ergeben Divine. Keine zufällige Zerstörung.

WELT:
Acht Gebiete: Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion und Tower of Eternity. Mit unterschiedlichen Monstern, Elitegegnern, Dungeons und Bossen.

WIRTSCHAFT UND SHOP:
Gold, Gems, Materialien, Rezepte, Schmied, Kostüme, Reittiere, Haustiere und Waffeneffekte. Gems müssen erspielbar sein. Free-to-play ohne Kaufzwang.

SPÄTERE FUNKTIONEN:
Echte Online-Ranglisten, PvP, Gilden und gemeinsame Bosskämpfe vorbereiten. Keine simulierten Online-Spieler.

ANDROID-OBERFLÄCHE:
Große Angriffstaste, Fähigkeitstasten, HP/MP, Inventar, Ausrüstung, Charakterprofil, Monster-Lebensbalken, Gold, Gems und Shop. Alle Spieltexte auf Englisch.

Erstelle ein tatsächlich spielbares, mobiloptimiertes Spiel mit dauerhaft gespeichertem Fortschritt. Baue zuerst das Kampfsystem, Charakterentwicklung und Ausrüstung stabil auf. Teste alles und behebe Fehler.

---

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build AETHERIA, a playable mobile fantasy clicker RPG with persistent progress, manual-only combat, progression, gear, world regions, and an English interface.

## Requirements
- Character creation: name, male/female, Angels/Demons, Warrior/Mage/Assassin with class-specific weapons, armor, and abilities.
- Manual attacks only—no auto-attack or auto-combat—with visible combatants, damage, HP/MP, skills, and boss attacks.
- Include XP/levels, skill upgrades, prestige, nine gear slots, rarity/tier fusion without destruction, drops, crafting, eight named regions, shop, earnable Gems, and prepare for real online features without fake players.
- Mobile-optimized Android-oriented UI, save progress persistently, test and fix issues, and keep all game text English.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone browser game in `index.html`, with localStorage persistence and no purchase flow or simulated online players.
- Character art is drawn with inline SVG; online services are explicitly marked as unconfigured.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a complete standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game foundation with responsive styling and persistent save model.
- Implemented manual combat, combat animations/damage, boss warnings and attacks, leveling, class skills/cooldowns, loot, equipment, fusion, crafting, regions, shop, daily Gems, and prestige logic.

### Active
- Finish the JavaScript: UI handlers and initialization are not yet connected; verify game behavior and fix bugs.
- Test desktop/mobile rendering and gameplay; no testing has been performed yet.

### Blocked
- The game currently ends with `bindOther()` in `index.html`; missing final `</script></body></html>`, startup call, and event-handler hookup means it is not yet runnable as a complete game.

## Next Move
1. Continue implementing `index.html`: connect `bindOther()` in `render()`, finish event wiring and add startup initialization plus closing tags.
2. Inspect/fix game logic, including region progression, dungeon behavior, stage switching, fusion and persistence edge cases.
3. Run the provided app/browser workflow, test character creation, combat, progression, gear, and mobile layouts; capture and inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
4. Summarize assumptions and test results for the user.

## Objective
- Finish and test AETHERIA, a playable mobile fantasy clicker RPG with persistent progress, manual combat, progression, gear, and an English interface.

## Requirements
- Character creation: name, gender, Angels/Demons faction, and Warrior/Mage/Assassin class.
- Manual combat with visible combatants, damage, HP/MP, skills, and boss attacks.
- Include leveling, skill upgrades, prestige, nine gear slots, deterministic four-item fusion, drops, crafting, eight regions, a shop, and earnable Gems.
- Mobile-optimized Android-oriented UI; persist progress; all game text in English.
- Prepare for real online features without fake players; no purchase flow.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone `index.html` game using localStorage; online services are explicitly unconfigured.
- Use inline SVG for player and monster artwork; do not simulate online players.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive styling, character creation, inline SVG artwork, and game logic/rendering for combat, progression, gear, regions, shop, forge, profile, and persistence.

- Fix malformed document structure: secondary-screen CSS currently appears inside `<script>` after an earlier `</style>`, causing a JavaScript syntax error (`Unexpected token '.'`).

4. Summarize assumptions and test results.

## Objective
- Finish and test AETHERIA, a playable mobile fantasy clicker RPG with persistent progress, manual combat, progression, gear, and an English interface.

## Requirements
- Character creation: name, gender, Angels/Demons faction, and Warrior/Mage/Assassin class.
- Manual combat with visible combatants, damage, HP/MP, skills, and boss attacks; include leveling, skill upgrades, prestige, nine gear slots, deterministic four-item fusion, drops, crafting, eight regions, a shop, and earnable Gems.
- Mobile-optimized Android-oriented UI; persist progress; keep all game text in English.
- Prepare for real online features without fake players; do not include a purchase flow.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone `index.html` game using localStorage; online services are explicitly unconfigured.
- Use inline SVG for player and monster artwork; do not simulate online players.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fixed the malformed document structure by moving secondary-screen CSS into the stylesheet; the page now has one style block and one JavaScript block.
- Added safe localStorage defaults and validation, per-region stage tracking, guaranteed dungeon item drops, and saved-stage return when a dungeon is entered.
- Ran `node --check` successfully on the extracted script.
- Browser-tested character creation, entering the game, manual combat, and the World screen; game rendered and navigation worked.

### Active
- Review gameplay edge cases and test gear, forge, shop, profile, persistence, dungeon flow, and mobile layouts; capture and inspect a screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Continue browser testing across gear, forge, shop, profile, dungeon, and save/reload flows.
2. Test responsive mobile layout and capture/inspect a screenshot.
3. Check final changes and report test results and assumptions.

- `index.html`: entire standalone game implementation.

- Changes are uncommitted.

## Objective
- Finish and test AETHERIA, a playable mobile fantasy clicker RPG with persistent progress, manual combat, progression, gear, and an English interface.

## Requirements
- Character creation: name, gender, Angels/Demons faction, and Warrior/Mage/Assassin class.
- Include manual combat, skills and boss attacks, leveling, skill upgrades, prestige, nine gear slots, deterministic four-item fusion, drops, crafting, eight regions, a shop, and earnable Gems.
- Optimize the interface for mobile; persist progress; keep all game text in English.
- Prepare for real online features without fake players; do not include a purchase flow.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone `index.html` game using localStorage; online services are explicitly unconfigured.
- Use inline SVG for player and monster artwork; do not simulate online players.

## Objective
- Finish and test AETHERIA, a playable mobile fantasy clicker RPG with persistent progress, manual combat, progression, gear, and an English interface.

## Requirements
- Character creation: name, gender, Angels/Demons faction, and Warrior/Mage/Assassin class.
- Include manual combat, skills and boss attacks, leveling, skill upgrades, prestige, nine gear slots, deterministic four-item fusion, drops, crafting, eight regions, a shop, and earnable Gems.
- Optimize the interface for mobile; persist progress; keep all game text in English.
- Prepare for real online features without fake players; do not include a purchase flow.

## Decisions
- Implement as a standalone `index.html` game using localStorage; online services are explicitly unconfigured.
- Use inline SVG for player and monster artwork; do not simulate online players.

- Prepare for real online features without fake players; do not include a purchase flow.
